newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Songwon says selling shares.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Songwon says selling shares.

text.p: South Korea's Songwon Color Co, a dye manufacturer, said on Thursday it would sell 42,900 shares of its own common stock on an over-the-counter basis to raise working capital.
It has set the sales price for the shares at 25,400 won per share.
After the sales, which are scheduled for Friday, Songwon would be left with 43,100 shares, or 5.01 percent of its stock, a company statement said.
Songwon's shares closed unchanged on Thursday at 27,000 won.
